mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the unemployment rate indicates a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns as consumer spending and business investment decline.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts reflects strong demand in the housing market, which positively impacts related industries and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Forward returns do not exceed the baseline mean when housing starts are rising.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production indicates stronger supply chains and economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Negative forward returns occur when industrial production growth exceeds 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: When the growth rate of real federal spending (RSAFS) exceeds the growth rate of real GDP (GDPC1), it indicates strong demand which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Forward returns do not exceed the baseline mean when RSAFS growth outpaces GDPC1 growth.

mechanism_narrative: High federal funds rates increase borrowing costs, reducing corporate earnings and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Positive forward returns occur when federal funds rate exceeds 5%.

mechanism_narrative: Growth in non-farm payroll employment indicates a strong labor market, boosting consumer confidence and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Negative forward returns occur when payroll employment growth exceeds 0.2%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts combined with a decrease in unemployment rate indicates strong demand and labor market health, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Forward returns do not exceed the baseline mean when housing starts rise and unemployment falls.
